US Pilot Rescued After Being Shot Down Over Iran

A United States Air Force pilot was rescued after his aircraft was shot down over Iran, spending two days evading capture before being recovered. Video footage reportedly shows the dramatic rescue operation. The pilot, identified as a colonel, recounted his experience, including a period of desperate prayer during his 50-hour fight for survival.
